watch.summary: The streamer rejects a high-ranked Rocket League player's 1v1 chat offer, lamenting that he only wants to play against bad, low-ranked players.

beats.what: Streamer scores a goal in Rocket League.
Streamer reads a viewer's chat challenge proposing a 1v1 as a Champ 3.
Streamer rests his head in disappointment, saying he only wants to hear they are Bronze level.
He jokes about wanting to fight players with 2,000 hours who are still in Bronze.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That is not what I want to hear. I want to hear I'm Bronze 4
watch.why: The streamer hilariously turns down a high-skill 1v1 challenge by shamelessly admitting he only wants to play against low-ranked players. His deadpan reaction to someone being good at the game creates an amusing subversion of typical gamer confidence.
